User.title: User
User.description: Represents the user's secure profile, learning metrics, completed activities, and credentials

email.description: The authenticated email of the operator

displayName.description: The display name of the user

profile.description: The operator's profile metadata including target role, language preference, learning style, and level metrics

learningState.description: The dynamic user learning progress, containing stats like XP, completed counts, scores, and track progress

activeCareerTrack.description: The current active career pathway of the operator (ETHICAL_HACKER or SOC_ANALYST)

careerProgress.description: The independent progress maps for each distinct career pathway

levels.description: The primary curriculum module levels and lesson completed markers

missions.description: Active cyber scenarios and task completed states

ctfChallenges.description: CTF arenas unlocked states and submitted flags stats

achievements.description: Earned reward achievements and milestone credentials

skillMasteries.description: Quantitative skill mastery records representing the cognitive understanding of security disciplines

mistakes.description: The historical journal logs of incorrect technical decisions and resolutions

trainingMode.description: Current cognitive study mode (e.g., MENTOR or EXAM)

toolReasoningScores.description: Detailed telemetry scores from command line interactions

certificatesList.description: Pre-seeded and dynamically generated completion credentials

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last synchronization event

BetaFeedback.title: BetaFeedback
BetaFeedback.description: Represents a beta tester's feedback response including ratings and freeform comments

writtenFeedback.description: Freeform written comments or bugs reported

users/{userId}.description: Top-level collection that acts as the single source of truth for the operator's laboratory progress

beta_feedback/{feedbackId}.description: Collection storing the feedback submitted by private and public beta testers
